mapper.sql: id, ticket_no, tenant_id, merchant_id, member_id, user_id, type, subject, status, order_id, order_no, after_sale_id, after_sale_no, assigned_admin_id, assigned_admin_name, last_reply_by, last_reply_time, first_response_deadline, first_response_at, resolved_time, closed_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_service_ticket WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM dms_shop_service_ticket ticket
ticket.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND ticket.status = #{status} AND ticket.type = #{type}
AND ( ticket.ticket_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ticket.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ticket.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ticket.after_sale_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.id = ticket.member_id AND (member.login_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))) )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ticket.first_response_at IS NULL AND ticket.first_response_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND ticket.status != 'CLOSED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE ticket.status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 WHEN 'WAITING_MEMBER' THEN 2 WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, ticket.last_reply_time DESC, ticket.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_service_ticket (ticket_no, tenant_id, merchant_id, member_id, user_id, type, subject, status, order_id, order_no, after_sale_id, after_sale_no, last_reply_by, last_reply_time, first_response_deadline) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{subject}, #{status}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{afterSaleId}, #{afterSaleNo}, #{lastReplyBy}, #{lastReplyTime}, #{firstResponseDeadline})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_service_ticket SET status = 'OPEN', last_reply_by = 'MEMBER', last_reply_time = #{replyTime}, resolved_time = NULL, closed_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND id = #{id} AND status != 'CLOSED'

UPDATE dms_shop_service_ticket SET status = #{status}, assigned_admin_id = #{adminId}, assigned_admin_name = #{adminName}, last_reply_by = 'ADMIN', last_reply_time = #{replyTime}, first_response_at = COALESCE(first_response_at, #{replyTime}), resolved_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') THEN #{replyTime} ELSE NULL END, closed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CLOSED' THEN #{replyTime} ELSE NULL END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status != 'CLOSED' AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}

UPDATE dms_shop_service_ticket SET status = 'CLOSED', last_reply_by = 'MEMBER', last_reply_time = #{closeTime}, resolved_time = COALESCE(resolved_time, #{closeTime}), closed_time = #{closeTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND id = #{id} AND status != 'CLOSED'
